name: Darnassus Marzipan
summary: At Hallow's End, Darnassus innkeepers hand out festive marzipan to visitors who dance for it. Crafted in the night elven capital for the autumn celebration, this sweet is one of four treats Jesper needs.

sections.title: A Taste of the World Tree
sections.body: During Hallow's End, Alliance capitals share a tradition of lighthearted trick-or-treating. Dwarves offer sharp mints, Stormwind makes chewy nougat, and Darnassus innkeepers prepare delicate marzipan for visitors. To receive a piece, you must show some festive spirit and dance when the innkeeper asks. The sweet is one of four regional treats sought by Jesper, a sick orphan in Stormwind's Cathedral Square who cannot go out to collect sweets himself.

faq.q: What is Darnassus Marzipan used for?
aliases: what do i do with marzipan
faq.answer: During Hallow's End, Jesper needs Darnassus Marzipan as one of four distinct sweets. He is a sick orphan at the orphanage in Stormwind's Cathedral Square. Bring it with candies from Ironforge, Gnomeregan, and Stormwind, and you receive a bundle of festive pumpkin treats.

faq.q: How do you obtain Darnassus Marzipan?
faq.answer: During Hallow's End, Darnassus innkeepers give you marzipan after asking you to perform a quick dance.

faq.q: Why can't Jesper get the marzipan himself?
faq.answer: Jesper is sick and cannot go out trick-or-treating. He is at the Stormwind orphanage in Cathedral Square and relies on adventurers to collect the distant treats for him.

angles.text: As a kaldorei, you can share the lighter customs of autumn. Darnassus innkeepers offer sugary marzipan to travelers who honor their hospitality with a lively dance.
As an Alliance traveler, you can gather treats from Darnassus, Ironforge, and Stormwind. Hallow's End brings the far-flung peoples of the Alliance together in shared festivities.
